data.name: Ablossomreddish
data.detailed_description:
Ablossomreddish is a fast-paced platforming and parkour game focused on precise movements and time-based challenges. Run, jump, and use your dash to overcome demanding stages filled with platforms, deadly falls, and secret shortcuts that only the most skilled players will master.

The story begins when your sister is kidnapped by a powerful corporation. Now, only you can rescue her. But the mission is far from simple: prepare to face brutal obstacles, unpredictable challenges, and enemies determined to stop your progress.

Each level demands quick reflexes, complete mastery of movement, and the ability to improvise under pressure. Time is your greatest enemy — every second counts, and any mistake could cost everything. As you advance, the difficulty ramps up, new dangers emerge, and the corporation reveals just how far it will go to stop you.

Will you be fast enough to reach her before it’s too late?

The fate of both is in your hands.

Story

On an ordinary day, the company Ablossomreddish discovers a very valuable area for sale in a certain forest. However, Keplifabcel (you) and your sister live in that place. Upon learning this, the company goes to your home to talk, but both of you refuse to cooperate.

Even so, the company insists on taking possession of the land and, as a last resort, ends up capturing your sister. Keplifabcel only discovers what happened after waking up and, desperate, immediately sets out to find her.

Now, Keplifabcel will try to intercept the corporation’s employee on the way to the company headquarters in an attempt to stop their plans and rescue his sister.

Commands

UP – Interact
DOWN – Move Down
LEFT – Move Left
RIGHT – Move Right
C – Jump
X – Enable/Disable Sprint
Z – Dash (forward)

data.short_description: A challenging platform and parkour game where every second counts. Run, jump, and perform precise moves to overcome intense and dangerous levels as you try to rescue your sister from the clutches of the powerful AblossomReddish corporation. Only the fastest and most skilled will make it to the end.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 630 / NVidia GT 740 / Radeon R7 240 or equal
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 760 or superior
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
